title: Table 4B Average site area per dwelling (apartments)
notes: Average site area column of Table 4B; used by C4.1.1. Transcribed from Chapter 4 Part 1 p51; values identical to current Table D multiple dwelling averages (C4P1-147). Average only: no minimum site area applies to apartments, and the dwelling-type column is removed. Unlike Chapter 3 Table 3B, the R10-R25 averages are not struck through: the maisonette / low-scale apartment reform is consultation only (Information Sheet 5), so they stay operative (C4P1-149). Values differ from Chapter 3 at R40 (115 v 220), R50 (100 v 180) and R60 (85 v 150). Explanatory Guidelines: yield = lot area / average site area, rounded down; residential component of mixed use only.
